### GitHub Pull Request #9051 harden lazy wheel wheel error handling
This change attempts to provide a catch-all safety net for circumstances where an index server is behaving badly when ranged requests are made.

Additionally, this change also helps guard against  missing "Content-Range" headers in specific scenarios.

### GitHub Pull Request #9049 Hash metadata as bytes
Because warehouse doesn't send a charset, this can get decoded as something other than utf-8, which doesn't encode (as utf-8) back to the same bytes.  For hash purposes especially, just look at the original bytes.
